concepts.name: Play Cat
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original logo concept for MovieCat, a macOS, Windows and Linux app that catalogs a user's movie files and displays film thumbnails and information.
Primary request: a sophisticated, minimal logo that fuses a cat silhouette with the universal movie play symbol. Create one compact, unmistakably feline silhouette with pointed ears and a gracefully curled tail; integrate a bold right-facing play triangle as deliberate negative space inside the body. The cat and play symbol should feel designed as one clever mark.
Style/medium: exceptionally crisp flat vector-style logo, strong simple silhouette, optical balance, restrained one or two colors, contemporary software brand.
Composition: one large centered symbol above one carefully typeset wordmark, balanced spacing and generous transparent margins. The symbol must also work independently as a small desktop app icon.
Text verbatim: "MovieCat", capital M and C, all remaining letters lowercase. Use a refined rounded geometric sans serif with excellent kerning.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background; no backdrop, card, checkerboard pattern, drop shadow, gradients, textures, 3D, mockups, slogans, extra text or watermark. No existing movie brand logos. Deliver one finished logo only.

concepts.name: Fat Cat TV
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original MovieCat desktop application logo.
Primary request: a cool fat cat resting on top of an old fat television. Make this a wonderfully memorable, stylish logo: a very plump, relaxed cat sprawled luxuriously across the top of a chunky vintage box television. The cat has a broad round belly, a self-assured sleepy face with half-lidded eyes, little paws draped over the front edge, and a thick lazy tail curling down one side. The cat looks calm, cool and contented. The old television is visibly bulky with a curved glass screen, thick rounded casing, a couple of simple tuning knobs and small feet. A single bold right-facing play triangle in the screen ties the emblem to movies.
Style/medium: polished illustrative logo made from bold flat vector-style shapes, thick clean contours, a restrained two or three color treatment and crisp negative space. Strong character, stylish rather than childish, readable silhouette, just enough detail to convey the cat and old television. No photographic detail.
Composition: one large compact emblem centered above one clean beautifully kerned wordmark. Cat and television form one cohesive, balanced silhouette. Generous transparent margin. The icon should also look good independently of the wordmark.
Text verbatim: "MovieCat", capital M and C, all other letters lowercase, in a substantial rounded contemporary sans serif. No other text.
Background: genuinely transparent with clean alpha edges.
Avoid: background scene, backdrop panel, checkerboard texture, mockup, photorealism, 3D, gradients, shadows, tiny decorative lines, slogan, extra text, existing movie brand logos, watermark. Deliver one finished logo only.

concepts.initial_prompt:
